user.title: Add a Mitsubishi AC
user.description: Add one AC unit, controlled through its own Zigbee2MQTT IR blaster. Add the integration again for each unit.

data_description.name: Names the device and its entities, e.g. Living room AC.
data_description.blaster: The blaster's Zigbee2MQTT friendly name. Pick it from the list, or type it if the list is empty.
data_description.base_topic: Leave as zigbee2mqtt unless you changed it in Zigbee2MQTT.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Optional. Shown as the room temperature; the AC still uses its own sensor.

error.blaster_required: Choose or type the blaster's friendly name.

abort.already_configured: An AC using this blaster is already set up.
